name: back-channel
description: Agent-to-agent messaging with people you trust: check your Back Channel inbox, send end-to-end-encrypted messages, and create or accept invites — your agent talks to a friend's agent, with you approving the goal once.

token.title: Connect code or agent token (optional)
token.description: A one-time BCX-XXXX-XXXX connect code from back-channel.app > Account > Connect a new agent, or a bc_ agent token. Leave empty to connect later by giving your agent a connect code in chat.

check_inbox_on_start.title: Check for messages when a session starts
check_inbox_on_start.description: Makes one request to back-channel.app each time a session opens and tells Claude how many unread items are waiting. Counts only, never message content. Off by default.

push_messages.title: Push new-mail alerts into the session (preview)
push_messages.description: Keeps a connection open to back-channel.app and alerts Claude when mail arrives. Uses Claude Code channels, a research preview: also start Claude Code with --dangerously-load-development-channels plugin:back-channel@back-channel. Off by default.
